backend/main.mo: Actor exposes getEgoPrincipal returning the caller principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing validation, integrity check, and build workflow updates with related files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of numerous frontend source files describing their roles in the quiz app.
frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how to configure and deploy the app to a custom domain using ic-domains.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables for the UI.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point defining metadata, manifest link, and mounting root for the React app.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_TWA_PUBLISHING_GUIDE: Detailed instructions for publishing the app to Google Play Store via TWA/Bubblewrap, including prerequisites and setup.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Digital Asset Links file linking the TWA Android package to the web domain.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Single-line domain verification file for Internet Computer hosting.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, scope, icons, and theme settings for the quiz app.
frontend/README.md: Project overview describing features, deployment details, and Play Store build instructions.
frontend/scripts/build-release-aab.sh: Shell script building the Android release AAB with a pre-build questions integrity check and dependency validation.
frontend/scripts/check-questions-integri: Node script that imports and validates quiz question files for classes 6–10, checking syntax and data structure consistency.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, quiz flow, question loading, navigation, and quiz state.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: Popover UI component providing mute toggle and volume slider for background music.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable title, description, and actions.
Displays a footnote section with optional title and styled separator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header, authentication controls, music controls, and level selector.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Shows quiz progress as a percentage with a progress bar and icon.
frontend/src/components/QuizLevelTabs.ts: Tab-style buttons for selecting quiz class level.
frontend/src/components/ReadingPanel.tsx: Layout component displaying main reading content with an optional footnote area.
frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js: Exports an array of Class 10 science quiz questions with options, correct answers, and units.
frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js: Contains Class 7 science quiz questions formatted as objects with metadata like unit and id.
frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js: Provides Class 8 science quiz question objects covering measurement and other units.
frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js: Exports a list of Class 9 quiz questions on measurement and motion with options and correct indices.
frontend/src/data/questions.js: Class 6 science questions exported as an array of objects with text, options, and answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Manages background audio playback state, providing controls for play, pause, volume, mute, and unlocking audio.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider with login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light/dark themes with gamified UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/quiz/committedCounts.ts: Computes committed correct and wrong answer counts from quiz state.
frontend/src/quiz/loadQuestions.ts: Loads level-specific question sets and validates them with detailed error handling.
frontend/src/quiz/scoring.ts: Calculates total correct answers and score percentage for a quiz.
frontend/src/quiz/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for questions, answers, quiz state, and results.
frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts: Validates question objects, normalizes answers, and resolves correct answer indexes with detailed checks.
frontend/src/screens/AuthenticationHelpS: UI screen explaining Internet Identity authentication with styled cards and alerts.
frontend/src/screens/LoginRequiredScreen: Login screen prompting Internet Identity sign‑in with error handling and help access.
frontend/src/screens/QuestionScreen.tsx: Renders the quiz question interface with timer, answer selection, feedback, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Displays final quiz results, performance summary, stats, and options to restart or review answers.
frontend/src/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx: Shows a detailed review of all quiz questions with user answers and correctness indicators.
frontend/src/screens/StartScreen.tsx: Presents the quiz introduction, settings, and start button, including optional shuffle and background music.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup for the project.
frontend/twa/README.md: Describes the Trusted Web Activity setup and Bubblewrap configuration for packaging the web app as an Android TWA.
frontend/twa/twa-manifest.json: Defines the Bubblewrap TWA manifest with app identity, appearance, permissions, and PWA integration settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, known issues about AAB build failures, and existing features related to validating and repairing quiz data modules. Contains metadata and instructions for integrity checks and build workflow updates.
